case.title: Synthetic Bilingual Database Case
case.description: A reviewed local SQLite case demonstrating the visual question-bank workflow.
case.provenance: Original synthetic content written for DQ QuestionBank Core

questions.body_chinese: 若 x + 4 = 9，则 x 的值是多少？
questions.body_english: If x + 4 = 9, what is the value of x?
questions.solutions_chinese: 等式两边同时减去 4，得到 x = 5。
questions.solutions_english: Subtract 4 from both sides to obtain x = 5.

questions.body_chinese: 一个长方形的长为 5，宽为 3。求它的面积。
questions.body_english: A rectangle has length 5 and width 3. Find its area.
questions.solutions_chinese: 面积等于长乘以宽，所以 5 × 3 = 15。
questions.solutions_english: Area is length times width, so 5 × 3 = 15.

questions.body_english: Every negative integer is less than zero.
questions.solutions_chinese: 负整数的定义保证它位于数轴上零的左侧。
questions.solutions_english: By definition, a negative integer lies to the left of zero on the number line.
